items.title: Snowman Relaxing with Outstretched Arms
items.alt: Leaning snowman with closed smiling eyes, spread twig arms, mint pom-pom cap, orange scarf and a red heart button.
items.description: The relaxed figure tilts backward with two round snow feet forward and both arms open wide.

items.title: Snowman Carrying a Brass Lantern
items.alt: Tall snowman in a wide gray felt hat and cream scarf holding a brass lantern by its ring handle.
items.description: The narrow head and stacked snow body make a gentle upright silhouette, with one branch arm extended beside the lantern.

items.title: Snowman Juggling Three Snowballs
items.alt: Laughing snowman in a purple and gold jester cap juggling three snowballs above its twig hands.
items.description: The bell-tipped cap and striped scarf add a playful rhythm to the arcing snowballs.

items.title: Snowman Sleeping in a Knitted Crescent
items.alt: Small sleeping snowman in a red nightcap and scarf nestled inside a cream cable-knit crescent cushion.
items.description: Folded twig arms and closed eyes create a quiet resting pose within the curved knitted shape.

items.title: Let It Snow Lettering with a Snowman
items.alt: Blue snow-capped lettering reading Let It Snow with a smiling gray-hatted snowman beside the final letter.
items.description: Rounded blue letters form a compact two-line greeting, finished with two snowflakes and a small pink-scarfed character.

items.title: Two Snowmen Peeking over a Wooden Ledge
items.alt: Two smiling snowmen in teal and red knitted hats leaning their twig hands on a snow-covered wooden ledge.
items.description: A round-faced character and a taller narrow-faced companion share a cheerful cropped window composition.
